text.title: FreshDrop, busy families with children in Moscow
text.products: express slots, a weekly plan, replacement of out-of-stock items
text.gain_creators: a fixed slot saves 30 minutes a week; the weekly plan removes repeat orders
text.pain_relievers: a reminder 15 minutes before the slot; replacement chosen by the buyer
text.gains: a dinner on the table at 19:00; no extra trips to the shop
text.pains: missed courier, wrong item, waiting for a slot that is always full
text.jobs: plan the weekly shop; get the food home on time
text.segment: families with 2+ children, Moscow; 14 interviews and 300 survey answers, August 2026; survey date 20 August
text.fit: covered: missed courier, slot availability; not covered: price of the express slot (buyers say it is high)
text.decision: launch the weekly plan for families; do not cut the express price yet; check repeat orders in 6 weeks
